description: Builds all sources of the project file in build order (assembler and BASIC, including conversion of BASIC to assembler and of media files). If the project file describes a disk, the command creates it afterwards. The results are in the build/ folder of the project.

Turbo BASIC XL projects (dialect turbo_basic_xl, Atari) with a disk in the project (section turbo, see vcc turbo provide) get build/<name>.atr: a copy of the disk with the translated program as AUTORUN.BAS. If the disk is missing, it stays a note (exit code 0).

args.name: project
args.help: Project folder (the first .vcprj in it) or project file. Without it, the current folder is used.

options.help: Builds only the start program (main in the project file). The disk is then not created.
Folder of the hardware database (data). Replaces VC_DATA and the automatic search.
Turbo BASIC XL: a missing user disk (section turbo of the project file) is an error (exit code 1) instead of a note.
Prints the licenses of all assembled sources (file, license, author, location) and writes them to build/LICENSES.txt.
With --license-report: the report as JSON on standard output (the OK/ERROR lines then go to the error output).

The build fails (code L002) if an assembled source is under one of these SPDX licenses, e.g. GPL-3.0-only,GPL-3.0-or-later (a trailing * is a wildcard, e.g. GPL-*). To make it permanent, use "licenses": {"deny": [...]} in the project file.

examples.title: Build the project in the current folder
List the licenses of the sources

notes: Each source gets a line OK or ERROR, and the start program is marked. Messages go to the error output.
Warnings about the project file (e.g. missing files from assets) come first. A project without sources is an error.

License note: If a program contains source under a copyleft license (GPL, LGPL, AGPL), a note (L001) appears on the error output. This is not an error. The line SPDX-License-Identifier at the top of the files is read. Files without it stay neutral. In the project file, "licenses": {"allow": [...]} allows a license (no note), and "deny" blocks it.

exit.1: a source or the disk failed, or no project file found
